Global investors bet on India's data centers despite modest GDP forecast

Global investors are showing significant interest in India's data center sector, with billions of dollars in investments anticipated. However, a Moody's report suggests that despite these investments, data centers may contribute only 0.13% to India's Gross Domestic Product by 2030. This indicates a strategic approach by investors who are betting on the sector's growth without necessarily acquiring direct ownership stakes.
